Public Executive Summary The CREATE program targeted development of a safe, low-cost, wide-temperature-range battery for grid and stationary applications. The WH-Power (WHP)–UMD–Yale team developed a zinc-pulp (Zn/CNF) battery system that combines an aqueous high-entropy electrolyte (HEE) with a cellulose-derived (Zn-CNF) ion-conducting membrane.
